verdict.rationale: PagerDuty can be driven without its UI through its own APIs. The REST API manages users, incident workflows, on-call lookups and manual incidents, authenticated with API tokens or OAuth and backed by a published OpenAPI schema. The Events API v2 ingests events from code repositories and automated workflow tools, including change events such as "pull request merged" and follow-up acknowledge/resolve events, which suits CI pipelines. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented first-party CI integrations (e.g., a pipeline action or plugin), CI-specific guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
